(2) She adjusts her hair with her left hand, fluffing it out to emphasize its massive volume while smiling and laughing at her reflection. In the background, a man is seen sitting on a brown couch. (4) An image of the character Edna Mode from 'The Incredibles' is superimposed over her torso as a humorous comparison. She continues to pose and smile until the end of the clip.
